title: No Es (quiz-first)
voice_notes: Remix variant — cold-opens on a prompt before teaching. Reuses lesson-04-no-es audio. No new TTS.

segments.say: Now you try: it is not normal.
To make it negative, Spanish does one thing. It puts no in front.
What about: it is not legal?
How would you say: it is not ideal?
Now listen to the flip. Same sentence, one word parked in front.
segments.show:
same sentence
one word in front

segments.say: You just park no in front. That is the whole move.

caption: Could you make it negative before the reveal? Spanish just parks no in front: no es normal, no es legal.
